messages:
maria: Pushed a small PR to tweak AuroraX variant aliasing + quant-profile note; also updated benchlinks and noticed the async SDK streaming snippet is still using the sync API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

chen: On it. Where's the broken link? :eyes:

maria: In model-catalog/aurorax/card.md around line ~78 — old bench link pointed to our internal runner. I replaced with a public gist but want someone to sanity-check the numbers (2k seq throughput/latency).

alex: Quick skim — bench numbers look plausible but the E2E latency for 2k seems low. Did you include KV-cache warmup and prefix caching? If not, add a note that numbers are cold-start vs warmed.

maria: Good catch. I didn't include KV warmup. I'll add a parenthetical. Also the SDK async streaming snippet uses the old sync `client.generate` call. Proposed replacement:

```python
# async streaming example using SDK v3 (async client)
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def stream():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key="REDACTED") as c:
        async for chunk in c.stream(model="aurorax-7b", prompt="Summarize this article:"):
            print(chunk.text, end="")

asyncio.run(stream())
```

sam: LGTM, but note our current API name is `stream` (not `stream_generate`). Also include `max_tokens=256` and a small `batch_size` hint in the example for clarity. Maybe a one-line comment about backpressure.

maria: Thanks — updated snippet and added `max_tokens=256`. Also added a compatibility note: the `aurorax-7b:quant8` variant doesn't support `longseq=true` beyond 4096 tokens; added a rollout warning and a short migration tip.

alex: Can we add a migration callout for teams on the `aurorax-lite` alias? Suggest recommending `aurorax-7b:quant8` and mention the ~1.3x latency hit vs non-quantized but ~2.5x cost savings.

ci-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #4321 — 12 changed files, 1 link-warning remaining (benchlink external gist). 

sam: :thumbsup: I'll approve once the two-line wording in the quant note is tightened (avoid implying parity with float32 perf).

maria: Done. Tightened wording + added a short note about testing with your prompt set. Merging in 10m if no objections. Thanks everyone! :party:
